1. Nicotine concentration in smoke particles varies directly with particle size. (Postulated)

2. Does particle size increase as nicotine content of smoke is increased?

3. Smoke deposits in the lungs consist of larger particles. Exhaled portion has fewer of the large particles.
number1: Nicotine concentration increases with particle size.
number2: Yes, particle size increases as nicotine content of smoke is increased.
